# sonarqube_group (Resource)

A SonarQube user group. Renaming a group updates it in place and keeps its members and permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_group" "developers" {
  name        = "developers"
  description = "Everyone who writes code."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Group description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_group.example 'developers'
```
